title: The Second Crib
hook: The parents gave me one rule: if the baby monitor ever shows two cribs, don't go upstairs.
lines: The first night I babysat for the Hales, they left me one strange rule.
If the baby monitor ever shows two cribs... don't go upstairs. Just call us.
I laughed. One baby. One crib. One little camera on the shelf.
By nine, she was asleep. The house was quiet, except for the rain.
In the second one, something was sitting up. Too long to be a baby. Too still to be a toy.
I called the Hales. It rang... and rang... and rang.
I didn't go upstairs. I just sat on the couch, staring at that grainy gray picture.
Then I noticed what was wrong with it.
The second crib wasn't in the nursery.
It was in the living room... right behind my couch.
